title: Rooftop Deck w/ Grill & Golf, 10 Min to Broadway
description:
Located 10 minutes from downtown, this quiet 2-bedroom and 2.5-bathroom townhouse is the perfect spot for a couple's or family trip! This home can accommodate up to 6 guests.

HIGHLIGHTS
- 3 Beds
- Rooftop Deck w/ Grill, TV, Golf, & Games
- Kitchen & Bathroom Essentials
- Two-Car Garage
- Washer & Dryer w/ Tide Pods
- Free WiFi
- Bag Drop Off, Early Check-In & Late Check-Out Options
- Smart Lock w/ Unique Access Code

The space
LEVEL ONE
The first floor features the front door and two-car garage.

LEVEL TWO
The second floor features the living room, sofa bed, kitchen, half bathroom, and washer/dryer.

LEVEL THREE
The third floor features both bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms.

LEVEL FOUR
The fourth level is the rooftop deck with seating, a TV, a grill, mini-golf, and other games.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home except for a locked owner's closet. They'll receive a four-digit access code before arrival to enter the unit through our Schlage Encode smart lock. Additionally, there will be an onsite lockbox accessible in case of a smart lock failure. We provide 24/7 customer support to ensure you never get locked out.

Other things to note
We are the following minutes away from these destinations by car:
- 10 minutes from Broadway, Ryman Auditorium, Nissan Stadium & Bridgestone Arena
- 5 minutes from Grand Ole Opry & Opry Mills Mall
- 10 minutes from the Nashville International Airport (BNA)
- 14 minutes from Geodis Park (Home to Nashville SC)
- 14 minutes from Belmont University
- 14 minutes from Vanderbilt University
